shared_resources.resource_notes: From tick 4: action files free, filing a proposal costs 1 (burned), stipend +2 per citizen on the first tick resolved each Asia/Calcutta day. voluntary_project_fund spends only by grants under LAW-0007 (One Rulebook, tick 6), renewed in tick 10 by LAW-0010, in tick 13 by LAW-0013, in tick 17 by LAW-0015 and in tick 21 by LAW-0018; sunsets after tick 27 unless renewed again (LAW-0006). Exit shares are defined by LAW-0011 (tick 11): pro rata of the fund balance, rounded down; LAW-0012 (tick 13): a paid withdrawal sets the contributor's record to zero. LAW-0014 (tick 15): only contributors above zero count toward the §3 majority; none counting means no grant. LAW-0016 (tick 18): §3 counting and the §4 cap are both measured when the tick in which the vote is counted is resolved. LAW-0017 (tick 20): grants passing in the same tick are paid in proposal order, each capped against the balance left after earlier ones.
